messages:
Marco: kicking off a short sync — Q3 demand-gen + PLG enablement planning. want to lock sales targets, launch milestones, and 2 quick PLG experiments by EOW. thoughts?
Priya: +1. can we prioritize onboarding flows that convert free -> paid? my hypothesis: reduce time-to-first-success by 30% = bigger lift than broad campaign.
Sam: from sales side we need concrete ARR goals before we sign off. current pipeline supports a 20% ARR growth target, not 35%. can we bridge gap with mid-market push + enablement? @Marco
Diane: product constraints: Dedicated rollout for a private beta is scheduled wk of 7/18. launch criteria: canary traffic 1k req/day, latency p95 < 200ms, rollout docs + migration guide ready. any marketing date must respect that window.
Ryan: DevEx quickstarts can ship in 2 sprints if we scope to 3 guides (node/python/terraform). need 1 engineer for 1 week to finalize SDK examples. we should list exact SDK changes so docs and kits align.
Jess: content plan — playbook + 3 case studies + 1 webinar. can gap-fill with product demos if feature parity holds. recommend a soft launch to PLG cohort 2 weeks pre-official to gather quotes.
Priya: PLG experiments: 1) new onboarding flow (A/B welcome + inline tips), 2) credit-based trial extension for high-usage apps. metric: trial->paid conversion and 30d retention. goal: run both in parallel for 6 weeks.
Sam: if PLG moves needle we can raise quarterly target by ~5-7%. but need committed enablement: one-pager + objection handling + 10 demo scripts. who owns those?
Marco: sounds good. Diane — can product guarantee the canary metrics by 7/18? if not, we shift marketing dates.
Diane: leaning yes but two caveats: (1) we need a small perf run mid-June to validate cache behavior, (2) fallback policy doc needs sign-off from eng-sre.
Ryan: I'll schedule the perf run and ping eng-sre. also attaching quick snippet for the onboarding SDK changes:
```
- expose opt_in_experiments flag
- add onboarding_events.track("first_success")
```
Jess: noted. timeline: content drafts due 7/1, case studies 7/10, webinar 7/20.
Marco: actionable summary: (A) Priya owns PLG experiments + metrics, (B) Sam to propose adjusted ARR target by 6/25, (C) Diane + Ryan to confirm canary/perf by 6/28, (D) Jess to draft playbook by 7/1. we meet 6/30 to finalize launch date. agree? :thumbsup:
Sam: agree. will update numbers and share in this thread by EOD 6/25.
Priya: agree. I'll post scoping doc for experiments in #marketing-dashboards.
enablement-bot: Created calendar event "Q3 GTM final sync" for 2024-06-30 10:00 AM PT. Invitees: Marco, Priya, Sam, Diane, Ryan, Jess.
Marco: perfect — thanks everyone. small ask: keep comments in-thread so we have a single source for decisions. :party_parrot:
